taste:
This curry combines earthy vegetables with a rich, aromatic coconut sauce. Roasted cauliflower provides the clearest texture contrast: the florets have a satisfying bite and gentle nuttiness, while the fresh spinach is tender. South Indian spices flavour the smooth sauce, so the appeal is as much about fragrance and creaminess as the vegetables themselves. The description does not establish a heat level, so check before ordering if chilli strength matters to you.

Served hot with fluffy rice and a warm naan, it offers contrasting textures across the plate. Rice gives the sauce a base, while the cauliflower keeps each mouthful from being uniformly soft.
